scope: engineering only; scripted fixture, no browser
checks: loading a run is read-only and skips a half-written last model-call line
an agent perspective holds only that person's received memories and own actions; another person's private text never appears
the researcher view holds every raw event and action, and both views carry their scope label
faded memories show only their encoded gist, and memories with no accessible representation are omitted
embedded run text cannot close the page script
before a live run writes its checkpoint, the cockpit shows the streaming model-call timeline
the live server binds to loopback and serves only the page and its data
